description: This file contains unit tests for the ExpressionResolver class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders package. It verifies various placeholder resolution scenarios including default values, string transformations, and deletions.

classes.name: ExpressionResolverTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the functionality of ExpressionResolver, focusing on placeholder resolution with various functions and default behaviors.

methods.name: setupExpressionResolver
methods.description: Initializes the ExpressionResolver instance with sample headers and placeholders before each test.

methods.name: testPlaceholderFunctionDefaultWithConstant
methods.description: Tests default value fallback when a header does not exist.

methods.name: testHeaderWithColon
methods.description: Verifies resolving a header value that contains colons.

methods.name: testPlaceholderFunctionDefaultWithPlaceholderNonExistingDefault
methods.description: Ensures empty result when default placeholder does not exist.

methods.name: testPlaceholderFunctionSubstringBefore
methods.description: Tests substring extraction before a delimiter.

methods.name: testPlaceholderFunctionSubstringAfterWithUpper
methods.description: Checks substring-after function combined with uppercase transformation.

methods.name: testPipelineStartingWithDefault
methods.description: Verifies pipeline processing starting with a default function.

methods.name: testDeleteIfUnresolved
methods.description: Tests deletion behavior for unresolved headers.
